reason: Verification failed with critical gaps: no disease transmission/health states or related metrics, a retailer stock reconciliation bug, and several required metrics/entities missing. One final iteration remains and can deliver substantial improvements by adding an S(E)IR disease module coupled to mask use, fixing the stock bug, and covering key policy/equity metrics and schedule/subsidy logic.

specific_areas: Implement DiseaseTransmissionModule with S(E)IR health states on Person (S/E/I/R), timers, and transitions
Couple transmission to mask use via source control and wearer protection; compute daily incidence, cumulative infections, and Rt
Fix retailer stock reconciliation by merging unpurchased allocations into the applied retailer stock update
Add required metrics: equity_gap_in_adoption, compliance_rate_in_mandated_locations, average_mask_availability, peak_adoption_rate, policy_cost, and npi_effectiveness (infections averted vs baseline)
Add policy schedule/mandate_start_day handling and subsidy/distribution logic affecting effective price and inventory

Align entities minimally with spec: extend Person (health_state, mask_status, age_group or proxy, mobility/workplace_id placeholders), extend GovernmentAuthority with schedule/subsidy fields; optionally stub MediaChannel or integrate into messaging inputs
Speed up calibration by downscaling N and T for trials (calibration_mode) and avoid per-trial IO
Tighten error handling (narrow try/excepts) and align module inputs/outputs metadata with actual buffer keys

task_understanding.adjustments: Reprioritize to meet core spec: disease transmission integrated with mask behavior and full set of required metrics. Treat media entity as optional if time-constrained but ensure policy schedule/subsidy and compliance/equity metrics are present.

data_analysis.adjustments: Plan for a baseline (no masks) counterfactual within the same seed to compute infections averted (npi_effectiveness). Prepare simple Rt estimation from simulated incidence (e.g., renewal method with fixed serial interval).

model_planning.adjustments: Define a minimal S(E)IR design (states, timers, transitions, contact process via venues). Specify mask efficacy parameters and where they apply. Set acceptance criteria: presence of incidence/cumulative/Rt metrics; retailer reconciliation fixed; compliance/equity/availability metrics emitted.

code_generation.adjustments: Add DiseaseTransmissionModule and integrate into module order; extend Person and Authority data classes; implement policy schedule and subsidy in relevant modules; correct retailer commit logic; ensure consistent buffer keys and types; keep changes minimal and testable.

code_verification.adjustments: Add targeted checks: (1) retailer reconciliation unit test ensuring unpurchased allocations return to stock; (2) presence and sane ranges for new_infections_daily, cumulative_infections, and Rt; (3) metrics keys exist (equity_gap_in_adoption, compliance_rate_in_mandated_locations, average_mask_availability). Reduce broad exception swallowing.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Run smoke tests with small N and short T; deterministic seeding; verify no runtime errors across typical scenarios (no mandate, with mandate+subsidy). Add calibration_mode downsizing for parameter search.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Evaluate whether incidence responds to mask mandates/subsidies; check Rt < 1 under strong mandates in plausible parameter ranges; verify compliance and equity gap metrics move in expected directions under subsidies/distribution.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Provide concise diffs or code insertion guidance for the disease module, retailer fix, and metrics; enumerate acceptance tests and how to run them; clearly flag any remaining non-spec features as future work.
